system.description:
Spaceship utility mount. An Equipment action restores the ship's shields to full and drains its Alien Power Cell. Holds one cell; reloading takes at least ten minutes. Alien artefact: making it usable by a human takes a Repair check (12, or 8 with 2,000cr and a week).

Exploration Supplement
